threats.title: Customer content memorized by the tuned model surfaces in suggested replies
threats.description: The model is fine-tuned on full transcripts including customer names, email addresses, and message bodies, with no redaction or filtering before training. A tuned model can memorize such content and emit it in a suggested reply for an unrelated ticket, disclosing one customer's content in another customer's context.
preconditions: sensitive content enters the training corpus unminimized
attack_path: customer content trains the weekly model
the tuned model emits memorized content in an unrelated suggested reply
threats.impact: Disclosure of one customer's identity or message content to another customer's thread

threats.title: Poisoned transcripts steer the tuned model's suggested replies
threats.description: Whatever reaches the training store trains the next weekly model. A customer who writes crafted content into tickets, or anything else that can influence transcripts, is writing into the model's future behavior; the documented write-path restriction bounds who can write the store directly, but the transcripts themselves originate with customers.
preconditions: crafted content survives export into the training store
attack_path: the nightly export carries them into the training store
the weekly tuning run learns them
threats.impact: Suggested replies steered by attacker-authored training content
